description: Source code for the SoftAMR class implementing an AMR audio decoder component in Android's media framework, including initialization, port setup, parameter handling, and decoding logic.

classes.name: SoftAMR
classes.description: Android media component class for AMR narrowband and wideband decoding.

methods.name: initPorts
methods.description: Initializes input and output ports for the decoder component.

methods.name: initDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the decoder state based on mode (narrow or wide).

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the decoder has been configured with input buffers.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates frame size based on mode.

methods.name: onQueueFilled
methods.description: Processes input buffers, decodes frames, and outputs PCM data.
